about.registryInfo: Lend SA - French-regulated tokenization platform; bonds issued under Article L.411-2 of the French Code Monétaire et Financier (private placement to qualified investors). Legal counsel: D&A Partners. Smart contracts audited by Hashlock (Final Report v2, Dec 2025). Each operation is structured through a dedicated SPV with Lend holding preferential rights. Omnichain via LayerZero.
